<style data-no-optimize="1" data-cfasync="false">
	.adthrive-ad {
		margin-top: 10px;
		margin-bottom: 10px;
		text-align: center;
		overflow-x: visible;
		clear: both;
		line-height: 0;
	}
	/* Set Gallery overlay above footer https://beta.dpreview.com/reviews/olympus-om-d-e-m1x-review */
div.imageViewer:not(.embeddedWidget) {
    z-index: 10000001 !important;
}

/* set height of gallery ad container */
body.noScroll #adSlot_image-viewer {
  min-height: 250px !important;
}

/* remove video styling */
.adthrive-collapse-player {
  border-top: 0 !important;
  border-bottom: 0 !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
}

#AdThrive_Header_1_desktop {
  margin-top: 0 !important;
}

/* set header max width at 100% */
.adthrive-header>div {
  max-width: 100% !important;
}

/* fix borders for video player in sidebar */
body.adthrive-device-desktop .sidebar .adthrive-collapse-player {
  padding-top: 5px !important;
  padding-bottom: 5px !important;
  height: auto !important;
}

/* JW - Adjust font-size for text before video play */
.jw-text-track-display {
  font-size: 5px !important;
}

/*
body.loggedOut .adthrive-close {
display:none !important;
}
*/



/* video background color translucent */
.adthrive-collapse-mobile-background {
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8) !important;
}

/* Places the close-out button on the right side of the footer */
.adthrive-device-desktop .adthrive-sticky.adthrive-footer>.adthrive-close {
    right: 10px !important;
    top: 10px;
    left: unset !important;
    color: #858585 !important;
}

/* hide video container */
body.novideo .videoWrapper {
  display: none !important;
}

body.ad-density-test div#adSlot_desktop-content-embedded_wrapper {
  display: none;
}

.raptive-content-terms-footer-link {
    font-family: Open Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif !important;
}

/* Center forum ads */
body.forum-with-ads .ad-banner-content .adthrive-content, 
body.forum-with-ads .ad-banner-below-stickies .adthrive-content {
  align-content: center !important;
}

/* set text before content ads */
body.beta-env .articleBody .adthrive-ad.adthrive-content::before {
  display: block;
  content: "Advertisement";
  text-align: center;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  padding-bottom: 10px;
  color: #666;
}

/* vertically align content ads */
.adthrive-ad.adthrive-content {
 align-content: center !important;
}


.ad-section--sidebar {
  min-width: 320px !important;
}

/* change CCPA styling */
.adthrive-comscore.adthrive-footer-message {
background-color: #0c0e12 !important;
}
.adthrive-ccpa-link {
font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif !important;
font-size: 10px !important;
}</style>
